purpose: Explain and correct the prospectively archived negative E3.1 Part A result without erasing or relabelling it.

data_role.dataset: PRESLHY E3.1 Part A ambient-temperature workbooks, DOI 10.35097/1187
data_role.prohibited_use: These 22 cases cannot be reused as independent confirmation of the revised model.

model_revision.internal_heat_transfer: Churchill-Chu all-range natural-convection correlation evaluated from HEOS hydrogen properties
model_revision.wall_energy_balance: lumped measured wall heat capacity with internal and external convection
model_revision.mass_flow: maximum real-gas isentropic mass flux from CoolProp HEOS
model_revision.parameter_policy: No experiment-specific parameter is fitted. The original global discharge coefficient 0.8 is retained.

diagnostic_screens.note: Screens are copied from the frozen first evaluation for comparability; passing is developmental adequacy, not external validation.

next_claim_gate: Freeze the revised implementation hash and a holdout protocol before opening any holdout numerical outcome file.
